mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in GDP growth below 1.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDP growth remains below 1.5% for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index above 2% signals expansion in manufacturing output, which historically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased corporate earnings and economic optimism.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when industrial production rises above 2% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS remains above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 6% signals weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when unemployment rises above 6% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in retail sales below -1% signals weakening consumer demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and economic pessimism.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when retail sales decline below -1% for 3 consecutive months.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when housing starts rise above 10% for 3 consecutive months.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPI rises above 2.5% for 3 consecutive months.
